==========================================
Import types in parentheses
==========================================

type A = (import("x").T);
type B = (import("x").T | undefined)[];

---

(program
  (type_alias_declaration
    (type_identifier)
    (parenthesized_type
      (member_expression
        (call_expression
          (import)
          (arguments
            (string
              (string_fragment))))
        (property_identifier))))
  (type_alias_declaration
    (type_identifier)
    (array_type
      (parenthesized_type
        (union_type
          (member_expression
            (call_expression
              (import)
              (arguments
                (string
                  (string_fragment))))
            (property_identifier))
          (literal_type
            (undefined)))))))

            (type_identifier))))
      (identifier)))

    (type_identifier)
    (array_type
      (generic_type
        (member_expression
          (member_expression

              (import)

                  (string_fragment))))

          (type_identifier)))))

    (type_identifier)

                (string_fragment))))

          (string_fragment))))))

==========================================
Labeled tuple elements named like keywords
==========================================

type A = [spoken: string, symbol: string][];
type B = [string: number, any?: boolean, type: string];
type C = [any?, readonly string[], unique symbol];

---

(program
  (type_alias_declaration
    (type_identifier)
    (array_type
      (tuple_type
        (required_parameter
          (identifier)
          (type_annotation
            (predefined_type)))
        (required_parameter
          (identifier)
          (type_annotation
            (predefined_type))))))
  (type_alias_declaration
    (type_identifier)
    (tuple_type
      (required_parameter
        (identifier)
        (type_annotation
          (predefined_type)))
      (optional_parameter
        (identifier)
        (type_annotation
          (predefined_type)))
      (required_parameter
        (identifier)
        (type_annotation
          (predefined_type)))))
  (type_alias_declaration
    (type_identifier)
    (tuple_type
      (optional_type
        (predefined_type))
      (readonly_type
        (array_type
          (predefined_type)))
      (predefined_type))))

==========================================
Unique as an identifier
==========================================

for (let i = 1; i < unique.length; i++) {}
declare const s: unique symbol;

---

(program
  (for_statement
    (lexical_declaration
      (variable_declarator
        (identifier)
        (number)))
    (binary_expression
      (identifier)
      (member_expression
        (identifier)
        (property_identifier)))
    (update_expression
      (identifier))
    (statement_block))
  (ambient_declaration
    (lexical_declaration
      (variable_declarator
        (identifier)
        (type_annotation
          (predefined_type))))))

==========================================
Call signatures with type parameters after a line break
==========================================

type S = {
  register: {
    (plugin: P): () => void
    <T extends R<string, object>>(plugin: P<T>): string
  }
}
x = a
< b;

---

(program
  (type_alias_declaration
    (type_identifier)
    (object_type
      (property_signature
        (property_identifier)
        (type_annotation
          (object_type
            (call_signature
              (formal_parameters
                (required_parameter
                  (identifier)
                  (type_annotation
                    (type_identifier))))
              (type_annotation
                (function_type
                  (formal_parameters)
                  (predefined_type))))
            (call_signature
              (type_parameters
                (type_parameter
                  (type_identifier)
                  (constraint
                    (generic_type
                      (type_identifier)
                      (type_arguments
                        (predefined_type)
                        (predefined_type))))))
              (formal_parameters
                (required_parameter
                  (identifier)
                  (type_annotation
                    (generic_type
                      (type_identifier)
                      (type_arguments
                        (type_identifier))))))
              (type_annotation
                (predefined_type))))))))
  (expression_statement
    (assignment_expression
      (identifier)
      (binary_expression
        (identifier)
        (identifier)))))
